svg.title: Agent Squad: one batch through the pipeline
svg.desc: Forge plans, Chisel opens two issues, the reader checks them for blockers, you lift the review gate, Ralph loops Cody over each issue (tests first, the second PR stacked on the first), you review with Reven (numbered findings, one contest allowed) and fix one note in a hook-opened worktree, retarget the child PR to main and merge both, and a checkpoint hook updates status.

g.text: Forge plans the change and sizes it
Chisel turns the plan into issues #12 and #13, both labelled needs-review
The reader checks the drafts: ## Readiness, and an open blocker marks the issue blocked
Ralph's loop, issue 1 of 2: #12 goes to Cody
Cody writes failing tests for #12, then code until green, then opens PR #12
Ralph loops, issue 2 of 2: #13 branches from #12's branch
Tests first again. PR #13 is stacked on #12's branch
You run Reven on each PR. Each diffs against its own base
Reven numbers its findings; Cody answers with FIX, CONTEST or ESCALATE and Ralph allows one contest
You fix a review note on #13 in a worktree opened by hooks (claude -w)
You retarget #13 to main, then merge #12
SessionEnd: the checkpoint hook updates status.md

svg.text: Both PRs under review: #13 is stacked on #12’s branch until you retarget it to main
